# Generating an LCM image and perform instant refine

```shell Shell
curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations-lcm \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 512,
  "height": 512,
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "A blue rose ",
  "style": "CINEMATIC",
  "strength": 0.65
}
'
# Note the imageDataUrl in the response

curl --request POST \
     --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/lcm-instant-refine \
     --header 'accept: application/json' \
     --header 'authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>' \
     --header 'content-type: application/json' \
     --data '
{
  "width": 512,
  "height": 512,
  "imageDataUrl": "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  "prompt": "A blue rose with water droplets",
  "strength": 0.65,
  "style": "CINEMATIC"
}
'

```

```json Response Example
{
  "lcmGenerationJob": {
    "imageDataUrl": [
      "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
    ],
    "requestTimestamp": null,
    "apiCreditCost": 5
  }
}
```

# Generate with base64 image

<!-- shell@1-16 -->

This command creates an LCM generation with an example body. 

To use this command, first replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with your API key. Then, run it in your terminal.

Note the imageDataUrl needs to be a base64 Image String and in .jpeg format only.  

Strength refers to Creativity strength. The higher it is, the more creative the LCM generation gets from your input image. The lower it is, the more similar it will be to your input image. 

Keep note of the imageDataUrl in the response for the next step.

# Perform Instant Refine on LCM image

<!-- shell@18-32 -->

To perform instant refine, replace the imageDataUrl with the imageDataUrl that returned in the previous call. Apply a new prompt or keep the same prompt. 

The response will contain another imageDataUrl with a base64 image that was instantly refined.
